caption_text:
HP mouse — full CGI product animation. No camera, no set.
Modeled, shaded, lit and animated in 3D, with the light trails, energy rings and atmosphere all built in. Glossy black on a dark background is a trap — no surface detail to hide behind, so every reflection has to carry the shape. The orbiting light streaks are animated geometry, timed to the camera move.
Reflective plastic, volumetric haze, and moving light. This is the level where a render becomes an ad.

Need product animation for your tech brand? DM us.

How does a Laser Computer Mouse Work?

Ever wondered how a computer mouse actually works? 🖱 Using clean and easy-to-follow 3D animation, this short takes you inside one of the most important tools we use every day. Beneath its simple design is smart technology working constantly in real time.

An optical sensor on the bottom of the mouse scans the surface thousands of times per second. A tiny processor compares these images to detect direction and speed, turning your hand movements into smooth cursor motion on screen. Each click activates precise switches that instantly send signals to your computer, while the scroll wheel uses a rotating encoder to control scrolling with accuracy.

Whether wired or wireless, the mouse communicates with your computer in milliseconds, making everything feel fast and effortless. From browsing and gaming to design and animation, this small device plays a big role in how we interact with digital worlds.

caption_text:
Concept 3D CGI product film for @bangolufsen Beoplay 100 headphones.

The focus was on refined lighting, macro-level material detailing, and intentional camera choreography to emphasize form, finish, and tactile detailing, allowing light and motion to reveal the product’s craftsmanship.

A key technical detail was the development of a custom stitching system for the headband cushion. It was built procedurally to ensure clean spacing, curvature conformity, and realistic depth.

Created in Houdini and C4D. No AI used.

Huge thanks to @Chinkrux for the incredible sound design. It added a whole new layer of energy to the visuals.

Concept 3D CGI product film for @bangolufsen Beoplay 100 headphones.

The focus was on refined lighting, macro-level material detailing, and intentional camera choreography to emphasize form, finish, and tactile detailing, allowing light and motion to reveal the product’s craftsmanship.

A key technical detail was the development of a custom stitching system for the headband cushion. It was built procedurally to ensure clean spacing, curvature conformity, and realistic depth.

Created in Houdini and C4D. No AI used.

Huge thanks to @Chinkrux for the incredible sound design. It added a whole new layer of energy to the visuals.

caption_text:
Destiny 1 — a concept gaming mouse

Medieval craftsmanship meets a modern desk. The form is built around a medieval mask shape at the base, with sharp, blade-like clicks inspired by the @razer Basilisk.

My work usually lives in minimalism and function.
But every time I visit an old city, I hear the same thing — “they don’t make that anymore.” So this time I designed against that instinct: something bold, ornamental, and unmistakably crafted.

Raw steel body, medieval mask-inspired base
Aggressive blade-like clicks
Engraving on the underside
Central LED screen between the buttons — raw steel meets modern light

Two worlds, centuries apart, in one object.

\\\ 等距投影風格 Isometric style 
等距視圖風格

近年來很流行的風格，出現在早期8位元的電動遊戲中，例如Highway Encounter(1985) ，

由於這種透視法跳脫現實，因此風格充滿現代科技感，大部分設計會利用較強烈、飽和的色彩，讓畫面更活潑亮眼。app『紀念碑谷』更是把這樣的風格發揮的淋漓盡致，等距視角帶出超現實的特色，並獲得2014年 蘋果設計獎。
�

\\\ Isometric Style
In recent years, this style has become very popular, appearing in early 8-bit video games, such as Highway Encounter (1985).

Since this perspective breaks away from reality, the style is full of modern technological feel. Most designs use strong, saturated colors to make the picture more lively and eye-catching. The app Monument Valley further exemplifies this style, with its isometric perspective highlighting its surreal characteristics, earning it the 2014 Apple Design Award.
